en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town surrounded by forested hills. Wooden houses and farm-like buildings line a straight dirt road that runs through the middle. In the foreground there are trees and fenced plots, and a sloping roof edge is visible on the left. The scene has an old, rural Scandinavian feel. In the upper left corner the printed word "Arvidsjaur" appears, suggesting the town's name.
